about: Kinds of question agents answer by hand with reads and greps of instruction files: what lesson covers this, what rules exist about running, testing and deploying, whether rules duplicate or are stale, how many rules there are, which file holds a rule. Each is put to bench/fixture/ankh-api, a small project with an AGENTS.md, a CLAUDE.md, a rules file with `paths:` frontmatter and a generated lessons file. Paths are relative, so run the bench from the kit's folder. The user-level files of whoever runs it are read as well, so the expectations name only what the fixture holds. Memory folders live under ~/.claude/projects and are not part of the fixture. Expectations are what the fixture holds as of 2026-11-21. Not yet run on a model.

questions.q: In bench/fixture/ankh-api, what lesson did mike record about tests that sleep for a fixed time, and what is its lesson id?
I want you to get me all the rules for how we run and deploy the project in bench/fixture/ankh-api: which files hold them?
In bench/fixture/ankh-api, which file holds the rule about deploying on a Friday, and when does it load?
In bench/fixture/ankh-api, do AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md repeat any rule word for word? Name one and give both lines.
The 'Shipping a change' section of bench/fixture/ankh-api/AGENTS.md names a release checklist file. Does that file exist?
Does bench/fixture/ankh-api/AGENTS.md name a skill that does not exist? Which?
